decisions.reason: The decision changes when surfaces 1 and 2 are finished relative to welding; it does not change the bushing's fit, guidance, or retention arrangement.
Finishing surfaces 1 and 2 before welding does not change the specified 45-degree angle between the lug hole axes.
The fabrication-sequence decision does not alter any specified part or bushing material.
The source does not change the sliding mandrel's piston-end or bushing arrangement; it only specifies pre-weld surface finishing.
The source changes the machining stage for surfaces 1 and 2 but does not change the main shaft's dimensions, stock, keyway, thread, or bushing-space geometry.
The surface-finishing sequence does not alter the rule for numbering drawings according to the assembly.
The source does not change the requirement to deliver a 3D assembly model and does not explicitly require a change to modeled geometry.
The requirement to provide a complete manufacturing drawing set remains unchanged; the revised fabrication detail is already owned by the welded-assembly fabrication Requirement.
